title: Crossroads of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: The Ultimate Chessmaster revealed a smile for the first time: "Ten thousand years, and finally someone presents a different answer—come, let me see how far you can go." Before the words faded, the entire chessboard space shuddered violently, and Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate burning in an unprecedented way...

text.content: Within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, that voice dormant for ten thousand years exploded like thunder, shaking his seven apertures. The aura of the ancient Chess Player surged forth like a tide, forming some bizarre standoff with the 'Ultimate Chessmaster' transcending all worlds. Chen Ji felt his entire meridians screaming in agony, as if two utterly different Dao principles were colliding madly within him—one vast and ancient, the other cold and transcendent.

dialogue.content: "You said the same thing ten thousand years ago, Cang Yutian!" The ancient Chess Player's voice carried undisguised fury, "You think changing your skin and name can hide your nature of toying with all living beings? Chen Ji is the successor I chose, not your chess piece!"

text.content: Ripples spread through the Void, and the silhouette of the 'Ultimate Chessmaster' woven from countless stars and threads of karma became increasingly distinct. It had no fixed form, yet exuded absolute pressure—as if the entire universe's will was gazing upon this ant-like struggle. Chen Ji felt himself placed under a microscope, every blood vessel and wisp of soul laid bare.

dialogue.content: "A chess game?" The Ultimate Chessmaster's voice carried no emotion yet made Chen Ji's soul tremble, "All of you are within the chess game. The Chess Player, the Game Breaker, the Discarded Pieces... all are merely parts of the game's operation. Cang Yutian tried to break the game ten thousand years ago, only to become part of it—" The voice paused slightly, "And you, Chen Ji, how will you choose?"

text.content: Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate draining furiously, that power of foresight activating involuntarily. Everything within three hours flashed before his eyes like a carousel—the Tianqing Sect's destruction, Su Qingyao's fall, Chen Nian being completely refined by the Holy Sect, the entire cultivation world reduced to a desolate wasteland... Every timeline pointed to the same endpoint: becoming the Ultimate Chessmaster's piece, or perishing with all creation.

dialogue.content: "So..." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice hoarse yet exceptionally calm, "You're saying I only have two paths—either become the new Ultimate Chessmaster, continuing this endless game; or watch everything descend into void?" A slight smile curved his lips, that grin carrying a terrifying madness, "Did you ever consider... a third path?"

text.content: The Void suddenly solidified. The Ultimate Chessmaster's 'gaze' seemed to materialize, and Chen Ji felt the pressure around him increase tenfold, yet he forced himself to stand straight. Mo Xiansheng urgently transmitted in his Mental Sea: "Boy, you're mad! It's probing your cards!" Chen Ji gave no response, merely slowly unfurling the Tianji Record Fragment, its damaged runes blooming with a faint yet defiant light in the Void.

Chen Ji felt the power of the Tianji Record boiling within him, that ability to foresee the future never so clear yet so agonizing. Every glimpse into Heavenly Secrets caused his Heavenly Fate to plummet—and now, he distinctly 'saw' three entirely different fate trajectories spreading before him. The first, a golden road leading to the Ultimate Chessmaster's position, the cost being becoming the next eternal prisoner; the second, a dark abyss leading to void victory, the cost being loss of everything; the third...

dialogue.content: "The third path," Chen Ji's voice echoed through the Void, "is not to destroy the chess game, but to—limit it." His eyes blazed with unprecedented light, "You designed this game spanning countless epochs, treating all beings as chess pieces. But have you ever considered... if the chessboard itself is limited, if every piece can choose its own moves, if..." He took a deep breath, "if the game must eventually end?"

text.content: For the first time, a fluctuation appeared in the Ultimate Chessmaster's 'gaze'. Chen Ji distinctly sensed a crack forming in that ancient, unchanging coldness—for the first time in ten thousand years, someone had touched the essence of its existence. Mo Xiansheng sucked in a sharp breath in his Mental Sea: "This boy... he actually saw through the core secret of the Tianji Record..." The ancient Chess Player's voice also fell uncharacteristically silent for a moment.

"Interesting." For the first time, something approximating 'interest' appeared in the Ultimate Chessmaster's voice, "For ten thousand years, countless geniuses have attempted to challenge the rules of the game—some wanted to become Chess Players, some wanted to destroy everything, some wanted to transcend... But no one has ever considered 'limiting' the game itself." In the Void, the silhouette woven from countless karmic threads seemed to lean slightly forward, "Tell me your plan."

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chessmaster rarely showed interest—this was a once-in-a-thousand-years opportunity. Chen Ji must give his answer at this critical moment—

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as the core, establish a Heavenly Fate Contract system in which all living beings can participate, allowing each life's choices to influence the game's direction, fundamentally shaking the Ultimate Chessmaster's absolute control.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the title 'Heavenly Fate Resonance', the Ultimate Chessmaster will acknowledge your existence
choices.risk_hint: This plan touches upon the Ultimate Chessmaster's core interests; it may strike directly after you finish elaborating

text.content: Chen Ji raised the Tianji Record Fragment high above his head, its damaged runes resonating with his bloodline, and a portion of ancient memory exploded within his Mental Sea—it was Cang Yutian's partial memory, the original 'design blueprint' of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: "Heavenly Fate Contract—" Chen Ji's voice no longer trembled but carried unprecedented certainty, "allows every living being to resonate with the Tianji Record. Their every autonomous choice becomes part of the 'Heavenly Fate.' No longer will one person control the game, but all spirits will jointly move the pieces!"

choices.description: Directly targeting the Ultimate Chessmaster's core weakness—the chessboard's boundary. Through resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment, rewrite the infinite loop game into a limited game with a clear endpoint, making 'victory or defeat' possible.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the title 'Realm Breaker', the Ultimate Chessmaster will acknowledge you as the first existence in ten thousand years to see through its essence
choices.risk_hint: Touching the foundations of the Ultimate Chessmaster's existence may provoke its full-scale backlash

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly recalled a detail Mo Xiansheng had mentioned on the first page of the Tianji Record: every chess game has boundaries, even the chessboards arranged by the Ultimate Chessmaster are no exception.

dialogue.content: "You claim the chess game is infinite—but infinity itself is a lie." Chen Ji's voice turned sharply cold. "True infinity is not the inability to end, but rather that every ending is a new beginning. But what if I insert a 'choice node' between every 'beginning'? Let all the pieces decide for themselves whether to continue this game!"

choices.text: A two-pronged approach, going all in
choices.description: Fusing the 'Heavenly Fate Pact' with 'chessboard limitation' to create an unprecedented new system—this requires consuming massive Heavenly Fate Value as a price, but the effect after success will be subversive.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 60 points of Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the title 'Tianji Rewriter', the Ultimate Chessmaster will engage you in a direct decisive battle
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value consumption is enormous; if you fail, you will directly fall into a weakened state, at the mercy of others

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made the craziest decision of his life—if he was going to break the game, he would break it thoroughly! The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment began reorganizing in an incredible way; the power from the ancient Chess Player resonated with his own comprehension, and two distinctly different Dao principles began merging.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Fate Pact grants all things the right to self-determination; the chessboard limitation provides an opportunity to end the game—combining both is my answer, Chen Ji's answer!" His voice echoed through the Void. "From now on, there will no longer be a game decided by one person alone, but a Heavenly Fate game played by all sentient beings!"

flags_set: 天命棋盘融合方案提出

text.content: Suddenly, a shocking wave swept through the Void. The Ultimate Chessmaster's 'gaze' was no longer simple oppression, but carried a complex and indistinguishable emotion—that seemed to be... shock? The ancient Chess Player's voice exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "Boy, you're insane! You're touching its foundations! It will never allow—" Before the words finished, the entire space violently trembled, and Chen Ji felt as if he was standing at the center of a universe-annihilating storm.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Ultimate Chessmaster's voice rang out again, and this time, an almost human appreciation had crept into its ancient, unchanging coldness. "For ten thousand years, the first ant to dare redefine 'the chess game' before me... no, you are no longer an ant." In the Void, the great existence woven from countless causes and effects微微波动, "Your plan has touched the foundations of my existence. Under the old rules, I should have erased you the moment you opened your mouth..."

text.content: Chen Ji felt the pressure around him suddenly vanish, replaced by an unprecedented lightness—and danger. Mo Xiansheng's anxious voice rang in his Mental Sea: "Be careful! It's testing you! This is probing the feasibility of your plan!" Chen Ji did not respond, only quietly gazing at the existence that stood above all worlds, awaiting its final verdict.

dialogue.content: "But I've changed my mind." An almost笑意 appeared in the Ultimate Chessmaster's voice—the first time in ten thousand years. "Ten thousand years of chess games have been too boring. All challengers repeat the same path—becoming a piece, betraying the piece, becoming a new chess player... Only you, Chen Ji, thought of 'changing the rules' themselves." In the Void, the threads of cause and effect began reorganizing in an incredible way. "Since you possess such courage, I will give you a chance—"

text.content: For the first time, something resembling 'respect' appeared in the Ultimate Chessmaster's 'gaze'. Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate Value dropping sharply, but at the same time, an unprecedented power was awakening within him—the perfect fusion of the Tianji Record Fragment and the residual will of the ancient Chess Player, as well as the crystallization of his own profound understanding of the universe's rules.

choice.prompt: The Ultimate Chessmaster gave Chen Ji a chance to change his fate. Faced with this rare opportunity, Chen Ji must decide how to respond—

choices.description: Directly accept the Ultimate Chessmaster's invitation for a direct decisive battle, proving your plan deserves to be realized through strength. This is the most direct and most dangerous path.
choices.visible_reward: If victorious, you will gain the Ultimate Chessmaster's recognition, and the new system can be established
choices.risk_hint: The Ultimate Chessmaster's strength is unfathomable; this battle is extremely perilous

dialogue.content: "Good." Chen Ji's response was only one word, yet it weighed like a thousand tons. He slowly raised the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, and the fragmented runes on it bloomed with light that did not belong to this realm. "For ten thousand years, the first time you are willing to heed a piece's voice—just this alone, this decisive battle, is worth it!"

choices.description: Before the decisive battle, negotiate conditions with the Ultimate Chessmaster first—ensuring that even if defeated, the seeds of the new system can remain in the world, preserving the ember of future resistance.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate Value for negotiation
choices.visible_reward: If negotiations succeed, gain the "Negotiation Right," ensuring the new system won't be completely erased.
choices.risk_hint: The Ultimate Chess Player may think you are stalling for time or harboring wishful thinking.

dialogue.content: "Before the final battle," Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "I have one condition—regardless of victory or defeat, the rules of your chess game must leave a single crack. Allow the seeds I've sown in the mortal realm to one day sprout." A faint smile curved his lips. "This is the wager, and the transaction."

choices.description: Not rushing into a direct confrontation, first stepping back to use this time to refine the plan and seek more allies. This requires immense patience, but can increase the odds of victory in the final showdown.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 20 Heavenly Fate to buy buffering time
choices.visible_reward: Gain the "Strategic Buffer Period," allowing you to contact allies and refine plans
choices.risk_hint: The Ultimate Chess Player may think you are chickening out, withdrawing the opportunity it gave you

dialogue.content: "You gave me this rare opportunity, and I am grateful." Chen Ji slightly lowered his head, his voice carrying an unexpected humility. "But I want to use this time to make some preparations—contact allies, refine the plan. I want this final battle to not be your solo performance, but a prelude to the awakening of all souls!"

text.content: The atmosphere in the Void suddenly turned heavy. The Ultimate Chess Player's "gaze" seemed to want to see through Chen Ji completely. That existence above all worlds fell into a silence resembling "contemplation" for the first time. Mo Xiansheng anxiously transmitted through the Mental Sea: "Kid, you're playing with fire! It gave you this chance as a test—if you actually bargain with it..." Yet Chen Ji still stood calmly in place, waiting for the Ultimate Chess Player's response.

dialogue.content: "Interesting." The Ultimate Chess Player's voice finally sounded, and this time, an emotion almost resembling "appreciation" had crept into its ancient, unchanging coldness. "For ten thousand years, all challengers have either groveled before me or ranted arrogantly—only you, neither humble nor arrogant, but treating me as an object that can be 'negotiated' with." In the Void, the outline woven from countless causes and effects rippled slightly. "Simply for this, I grant you this buffer period."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his Heavenly Fate plummeting, but simultaneously, the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment were reorganizing in an unprecedented way—that was the last trace of power left by the ancient chess player, resonating with his will. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in the Mental Sea, carrying a hint of relief: "Kid, you did it... For the first time in ten thousand years, someone has made this existence change the rules themselves. Though just a crack, it's enough..."

The Ultimate Chess Player's "gaze" focused again, and this time, an unprecedented smile had appeared in that ancient, unchanging coldness—the first expression anyone had seen in ten thousand years. "Chen Ji," its voice echoed through the Void, "I admit, I misjudged you. You are not a chess piece, not a chess player, but—the rewriter of rules themselves." In the Void, countless threads of cause and effect began weaving in an entirely new way. "Ten thousand years, and finally someone has proposed a different answer—come, let me see how far you can go."
